specs.identity: Lumi, cobalt/periwinkle blue ghost with white aviator goggles, the EXACT small round head, long curved tapering tail, tiny mitten hands, the slight clockwise head tilt, highlights and proportions of the reference.
specs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, identity-preserve. Production sprite asset for an existing character; the attached cover image is the strict identity master, NOT loose inspiration.
Make a landscape 1536 x 1024 PNG on genuine transparent alpha. NO white background, checkerboard, glow or ground shadow.
Layout:
LEFT 1024 x 1024 square: reproduce the attached square cover scaled uniformly into this square, retaining the EXACT head-to-body ratio, silhouette, pose, tilt, material, hue and accessory positions, and identical subject placement/margins. Lumi, cobalt/periwinkle blue ghost with white aviator goggles, the EXACT small round head, long curved tapering tail, tiny mitten hands, the slight clockwise head tilt, highlights and proportions of the reference. Change ONLY these things in this left panel: remove the two arms/hands (and any held croissant), reconstruct the small covered torso areas smoothly; remove eyes, eyebrows and mouth, leaving continuous matching jelly skin where they were. Preserve cheek shading and the original 3D lighting. This faceless torso will receive the ORIGINAL cover's eyes and mouth as separate animated layers, so do not move or resize the head, facial area, body or tail. No legs or feet.
RIGHT 512-pixel strip: upper third contains the detached original screen-left tiny arm and mitten as ONE connected piece with a short rounded shoulder root; middle third contains the detached original screen-right arm and mitten as one connected piece. Preserve the original tiny rounded hand shape and material, not muscular or elongated arms. Leave transparent margin around each. Leave the bottom third empty.
Keep everything strictly inside its panel. No grids, dividers, labels, extra limbs, face parts, or extra characters. The goal is the SAME character from the cover, disassembled for a 2D skeleton; never redesign it or exaggerate its head/body. Preserve the original cover proportions exactly.

composition: soul-puppet.mjs uses original cover eyes, brows and mouths in the unchanged 1254px cover coordinates. New separated body and hand textures animate with fixed shoulder pivots. Cover files and QR images are unchanged.
mouthAnimation: Rest retains the original cover mouth. Speech adds SVG cavity, tongue, lip glint and closed-mouth poses at the same facial landmark. PCM energy and roughness drive smooth changes using the actual audio playback clock; this is expressive approximation rather than phoneme recognition. No generated or original artwork files changed for mouth1.
